parsed.why: No trans criminalisation, but 2025-recorded police harassment at identity checks and arbitrary public-order arrests hit the traveller's exact encounters; stigma, no non-discrimination claim, unregistrable NGOs leave thin recourse.

Gender nonconformity itself criminalised under uncodified sharia with flogging to death; documented arrests for cross-dressing, mass lashings, a trans woman dead in custody, airport arrests over posts, rainbow-goods seizures.

Sodomy felony retained, routine police pretext arrests and extortion, plus court-found nonconsensual gender determination in custody — tier-1 state exposure; courts repeatedly grant trans relief, but hostility and a stalled death-penalty bill persist.

Sodomy law uncommonly enforced but used against victims after attacks; concealment the norm, no trans-specific targeting or violence documented, no domestic HRT, hostile bills pending — latent statute plus thin recourse.

No criminalisation, no documented anti-trans violence or police targeting, and prosecutorial guidance treats GI hostility as aggravating; offset by a 2024 state campaign against LGBTQ advocacy and conservative, thinly-recoursed social climate.
